sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 192-340 KB. Parsed from the single <table class="tier-list">: the first <td> of each row is the letter, and each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt is looked up WHOLE against the roster rather than split at a space - the rule that keeps the six two-word-class specs matchable. Per-page counts printed and reconciled against the 27+7+6=40 roster shape BEFORE merging: raid 27/7/6 + M+ 27/7/6 = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, and apply-ratings was re-run to prove the match (the git diff on data/specs.json stayed empty for this source). ZERO tier moves, raid and M+ alike, for the second night running. Era read from each page's own title AND body, never a substring count: four titles self-identify Patch 12.1 / Season 2, and two carry a stale-era title over a Season-2 body - the raid HEALER page ("Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight", 21 Season-2 mentions against 6 Season-1) and the raid DPS page ("Midnight (12.1)", 54 against 14). Body over title, the blue-tracker precedent; seasonVerified stays s2 on all six and no value changed, so freeze-season.mjs has nothing to do (and on the runner it is the publish job's step, never the agent's). published re-read from each page's JSON-LD dateModified rather than carried forward, and unchanged: raid DPS 2026-08-16, raid healer 08-13, raid tank 08-08, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-16, agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Page snapshots advanced 08-22 -> 08-23.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 159/166 KB. Parsed from the tier__title MARKUP blocks: the id occurs 11 times per document and 7 of those are CSS rules, so the anchor is class="tier__title"[^>]*> and the block runs to the next such anchor; each entry's data-original-title is the "Spec Class" string, looked up whole. Raid 4 tier blocks / 40 rows, M+ 40 rows, 0 roster-matching unmatched, 0 tier moves. The M+ page again carries 8 tier blocks - 4 spec tiers plus 4 dungeon-difficulty blocks - and the extras were rejected by ROSTER MATCH rather than by position: Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale and Voidscar Arena all fail to map, which is exactly the intended behaviour. Era verified from the ranking body, not the title: the raid page reads "the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss", the M+ page "Method's Mythic+ Spec and Dungeon Tier List for Midnight Season 2" under Tactyks' byline. seasonVerified stays s2 on both, unchanged. Method's in-body dates are unchanged from 08-22 - "Last Updated 10th August 2026" (raid) and "13th August 2026" (M+) - and are still NOT written to sources.json, because fetch-published.mjs does not cover method and a stored published value there would sit permanently un-cross-checked by the published gate; that remains an owner call. Page snapshots advanced 08-22 -> 08-23.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai stays untried, it is IP-403 on /guide/* since 2026-08-03), HTTP 200, 73-339 KB. Parsed by unescaping backslash-slash to slash across the WHOLE document FIRST and then searching for [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list], selecting the block with the most [spec-badge=] hits rather than anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml( - the anchor that returned 0 rows off the raid-healer decoy in the 08-01 incident. Exactly one block per page; badge counts 27/7/6 raid and 27/7/6 M+ = 80, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Tier labels parsed with tolerant whitespace: S/A/B/C on the three raid pages, S/A/B/C on M+ healer, A+/A/B/C on M+ DPS (the documented A+, and still no S-tier spec in that cut) and S/A/B on M+ tank. All six titles self-identify Season 2 and the bodies agree (S2 mentions run 28-68 against 2-15 for S1). published re-read per page from JSON-LD and unchanged, matching published-evidence/evidence.json 6/6: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid healer 08-18, raid tank 08-14, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-18. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six, no value changed. Page snapshots advanced 08-22 -> 08-23.

The two brackets remain in different states and the M+ half recut for the second night. All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, 52-92 KB, parsed from <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists (NOT page.tierLists), entries resolved from each entry's icon "Class-Spec" token rather than the display name, with tiers[].entries treated as a list OF LISTS. M+ (metric "score"): 27/7/6 = 40 entries, 0 unmatched, and 13 of the 40 letters MOVED, with lastUpdated advancing 2026-08-21T12:00:00Z to 2026-08-22T12:00:00Z. Upstream recut, not a parse artifact, proven three ways on the same fetch: all 40 underlying scores rose (Assassination 2961->2986, Arms 2962->2985, Arcane 2952->2975), the parse counts rose with them (Arms 238,025->324,536) and the page total went 1,626,924 -> 2,353,508. Five specs moved A->S (Fury, Windwalker, Shadow, Marksmanship, Demonology), four B->A (Frost DK, Devastation, Beast Mastery, Holy Priest), three B->C (Augmentation, Affliction, Frost Mage) and Preservation C->B - every move exactly ONE Archon band. Downstream that produced 4 consensus letter moves, all one band and none two-band (Augmentation M+ B->C, Affliction M+ B->C, Marksmanship M+ B->A, Fury M+ B->A), against anomaly limits of 25 total / 6 two-band - the gate is not tripped and no ack is proposed. RAID: all three tierLists (popularity, throughput, survivability) again returned 0 entries, so no raid letter could be refreshed, while the chrome stays Season-2 (encounterOptions = the nine Venomous Abyss bosses, description "tier list for The Venomous Abyss ... in 12.1"). seasonVerified DELIBERATELY left at s1 on the three raid pages, for the reason recorded 08-21 and unchanged: the stored ratings.raid.archon letters ARE Archon's SEASON-1 letters, so flipping the flag would average them into the S2 raid consensus (the two-seasons-in-one-number lie DECISION 1 exists to prevent) and would publish a fabricated movement event tonight plus a second real one when genuine S2 letters land; and with an empty DPS list there is no Devourer entry to era-verify against, so "unverifiable -> skip, never guess" applies. M+ stays s2. No seasonVerified value changed anywhere this run. Recorded partial rather than success because half the source could not be refreshed at all.

NOT REBUILT; the stored data is byte-identical (619 tier rows across 9 Season-1 bosses + 8 Season-1 dungeons, top-level season stamp "s1", so the UI's Fight selector stays correctly hidden). The whole Season-2 encounter set was probed rather than the two registry URLs alone, and the split is unchanged from 08-22. M+ PER-DUNGEON IS FULLY AVAILABLE: all 8 Season-2 dungeon pages return a populated score tierList at 27 DPS entries each, lastUpdated 2026-08-22T12:00:00Z, totalParses 239,360-350,939 (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Sethraliss - slug "sethraliss", "temple-of-sethraliss" 404s - The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena). RAID PER-BOSS IS NOT: all 9 Season-2 bosses publish 0 throughput entries; only Nek'zali (26) and Nymrissa (27) publish survivability at all, and Nymrissa is a world boss - the measured dead end of 08-21. WHY NOTHING WAS WRITTEN: data/encounter-tiers.json carries ONE top-level season stamp, so an M+-only rewrite would either mix an S2 dungeon half with an S1 boss half under "s1" (mislabelled data) or stamp "s2" and un-hide the Fight selector over nine Season-1 bosses; and 8 x 27 = 216 tier rows is far under this requirement's 440-row floor. It becomes one clean reviewed change the day Archon publishes raid throughput; until then the stale red is the honest signal. Page snapshots left at 2026-08-18, the date the stored data actually comes from - bumping them would clear the staleness gate on data that was not refreshed.

The survivability read comes from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages, and those pages returned it EMPTY again tonight (0 entries) alongside throughput and popularity - the same Season-2 rebuild state described in the archon-tiers row. The pages fetched fine (HTTP 200, 52-64 KB, __NEXT_DATA__ parsed, specTierListSection.tierLists present with all three metrics listed and every one carrying zero entries), so this is an upstream no-data state and not a parse failure - proven on the same run by the M+ pages, where the identical code path returns 27/7/6. The per-boss substitute was re-checked ONLY to see whether the aggregate had recovered, never as a candidate source: Nek'zali publishes 26 survivability entries and Nymrissa 27, the other seven bosses and all three aggregates publish zero - the same 2-of-9 coverage the 2026-08-21 measurement rejected on four independent grounds (world boss, fight artifact with 55% of tiers disagreeing between the two bosses, n = 1-2, and the aggregate being the registered page). spec.survivability left untouched for all 40 specs. It clears when Archon publishes S2 raid survivability tiers, which needs real raid parses first.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" still cannot be honestly refreshed, though the Season-2 raid trickle keeps growing. Read from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data[] as the recipe specifies: the raid DPS page now returns 20 rows (was 19 last night, 13 the night before) and the tank page 4, at lastUpdated 2026-08-22T12:00:00Z - but page.totalParses still reads 0 and every row carries n = 1-10, so this is still the first trickle of Season-2 logs and not a usable cut. Merged nothing, deliberately: measured against stored (2026-08-16, n = 95-627 per row) the merge would shrink the series from 33 rows to 20 - straight through this requirement's 25-row floor and the 0.25 maxRowDropPct limit - on single-digit parse evidence. The stored values are themselves Season-1 numbers dated 08-16 and stay put until Archon has real S2 raid parses. Owner-accepted standing red: do not ack it away and do not raise maxAgeDays; it clears when totalParses moves off 0.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" is in the same state as archon-metrics and is reported separately rather than coupled to it, per the split-row rule. The Season-2 raid healer page's specRankingsSection returns 6 rows (unchanged from last night), but page.totalParses is still 0 and the parse counts are n = 2-5, against stored n of 250-390. Merged nothing; the series would also drop from 7 rows towards the 5-row floor on single-parse evidence. All 7 stored HPS values (2026-08-16) left byte-identical. Clears with real S2 raid parses.

Refreshed and merged: 40/40 rows advanced. All three Season-2 M+ pages returned specRankingsSection.table.data at 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched, page lastUpdated 2026-08-22T12:00:00Z (was 2026-08-21T12:00:00Z) and totalParses 2,353,508 / 784,359 / 784,385 (was 1,626,924 / 542,213 / 542,193). Every score moved up and every parse count with it - Assassination Rogue 2961 -> 2986 (n 40,628 -> 57,999), Arms Warrior 2962 -> 2985 (n 238,025 -> 324,536), Arcane Mage 2952 -> 2975 - the expected shape for week one of a season as keys climb. Largest single move is 4.8%, far under maxValueMovePct 0.6. Values stored as integers to match the stored precision, n = each row's parses. asOf is the SOURCE's own cut date 2026-08-22, never the run date; it is within the 1-day window the manifest success cross-check applies, which is why this row can claim success while the Archon raid rows cannot.

Half the series refreshed and half could not, so the coverage date correctly does not move (the min-60th-freshest of 80 rows is a raid row at 2026-08-16). The 40 M+ Popularity rows were re-parsed from the three Season-2 M+ pages and MERGED at the stored 1-dp precision after the shape check passed: each of the three role groups sums to 100.10 / 100.10 / 100.00 percent, every value is a plausible percentage, and no row equals that spec's own DPS figure. 63 of the 80 submitted M+ score+popularity values moved. The 40 RAID rows sit behind the same Season-2 rebuild as archon-metrics: only 20 DPS / 6 healer / 4 tank rows exist, each at n = 1-10 with page.totalParses 0, and their popularity values are shares of a handful of parses, which would be meaningless as a spec-popularity figure and would delete 10+ of the 40 stored raid rows. Merged nothing on the raid side; those 40 stored rows are byte-identical.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl, no headers, no proxy, no auth; the wowmeta.com HTML is a stale S3 prerender and was not touched. manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39.026Z) and the rankings file's Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT AGREE, so this is not the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest shape where a frozen manifest hid a moving payload. The payload was diffed anyway rather than trusted to the manifest: 44 blocks, whitelisting categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === "lowerBound" AND keyRange === undefined (a whitelist, not a "dungeon" blacklist - melee and ranged are subsets of dps and would double-count 27 specs) gives 3 blocks and 27+7+6 = 40 rows, classSpec names matching the roster 40/40 with no mapping table. ALL 40 lowerBound values are identical to stored AT THE STORED 1-dp PRECISION; rounding to the stored convention first is exactly what stops this reading as "40 of 40 moved". Genuinely frozen upstream, 12 days now - nothing to merge, so the coverage date correctly stays 2026-08-11. Owner-accepted standing red; it clears when WoWMeta re-runs its pipeline.

The 27 stored "Median rDPS (Mythic, all bosses)" rows plus the HPS, tank and healer-DPS rows stay byte-identical at 2026-08-10. This is the owner-accepted standing red from the 2026-08-18 flip - the red IS the honest staleness signal (Bloodmallet precedent); do not ack it away.

Fetched and parsed cleanly, but UPSTREAM HAS NOT RECUT and the page says otherwise in prose - worth recording, because last night's run read that prose as freshness. All 3 meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 70.9 / 42.0 / 40.6 KB; 40/40 rows parsed from the meta-item blocks, 0 unmatched, counts reconciled at 27/7/6. Every page displays "Updated 29 minutes ago", but its own machine-readable stamp is <time datetime="2026-08-22T05:48:15Z"> (healer 05:48:13Z, tank 05:48:16Z): the relative phrase is baked in at page-generation time and never re-renders, so a 29-hour-old cut still reads "29 minutes ago". A cache-busted re-fetch (Cache-Control: no-cache plus a random query string) reproduced the identical timestamps and byte sizes, ruling out the Cloudflare cache HIT. The corroborating evidence is the data itself: ALL 40 ceiling values are byte-identical to stored, which is consistent with a source that has not recut and inconsistent with a parse drift. Merged nothing; asOf stays 2026-08-22 and the page snapshots were deliberately NOT bumped to today on data that did not move. Murlok claims an 8-hour cadence, so it is overdue; the age gate (maxAgeDays 5) is not yet breached.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 attempts each. 17 specs return real data and the SAME 10 as the last four nights still return the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every retry - Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms and Fury - while the other 17 succeed interleaved in the same minutes, so the endpoint is demonstrably healthy and those specs simply have not been re-simmed. Every one of the 17 reads simc_settings.tier = MID2 (read off each chart, never hard-coded), ptr the string "0", and its OWN chart timestamp 2026-08-19. Stored is 26 profiles at MID1 dated 2026-07-08 (Elemental Shaman 07-15). MERGED NOTHING, and the reason is the tier gate rather than caution: a pool of 17 MID2 + 9 MID1 fails validate.mjs's uniformity check outright; fightLabels pools every DPS profile into one flat array with no provenance key and MID2 runs a mean 1.79x MID1, so a partial merge would publish WHICH SPECS WERE RE-SIMMED as if it were spec strength; and "adopt what exists, null the rest" leaves 17 of 26, under the 19-row drop floor. Adopt MID2 wholesale or not at all - possible only when all 27 charts carry it, and it will need a human value_move_ack when it does. asOf is the chart's own timestamp and was never stamped with the run date, so the coverage date honestly stays 2026-07-08 and the age gate going red IS the signal that upstream has not finished re-simming.

The standing recipe ran and the answer is still hold-MID1, but HALF THE OBJECTION HAS CLEARED and the owner should know. MID1_Raid.txt is a 272-byte LIVE IN-PROGRESS run with no "DPS Ranking:" block (header: SimulationCraft 1210-01, 12.1.0.69404 Live, hotfix 2026-08-22/69404, git build HEAD 325b18000c), so the recipe falls through to MID1_Raid.html - which fetched fine at 37.2 MB and is still the 2026-08-08 report: SimulationCraft 1205-01, 12.0.7.68974 Live, Timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28:33. That is byte-for-byte the provenance of the 26 stored rows, so there is nothing to re-merge. MID2_Raid.txt now reads 12.1.0.69404 LIVE where last night it read 12.1.0.69382 PTR, and it carries a complete 33-profile "DPS Ranking:" block - so the PTR objection recorded in this requirement's label no longer holds. It is still not adoptable on COVERAGE: mapped by longest-prefix (allowing hyphens), those 33 profiles cover 17 of the 26 stored DPS specs and are missing Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms and Fury - the same nine Bloodmallet cannot sim either. Adopting would shrink the series 26 -> 17 rows, a 34.6% drop against maxRowDropPct 0.25, and mixing two sim tiers under one series name is the failure the Bloodmallet tier gate exists to stop. Merged nothing; all 26 rows byte-identical. When a complete Live MID2 lands it will need a human value_move_ack.

Fetched and parsed cleanly; the period has not been recomputed, so there was nothing to merge. /period/latest 302s to period 1077 again - the same period as last night, which the page identifies as "week 1 of MID2" (Lindormi's Guidance, Xal'atath's Bargain: Pulsar, Fortified, Tyrannical, Xal'atath's Guile) - and its stats line is character-for-character last night's: top 2000 keys / 10,000 characters (3,582 unique) / 14.3 average key level. So this is not the half-landed weekly roll the recipe warns about; it is a period that simply has not been recut. The parse was BOUNDED to the "Spec representation in top keys" section (ending at the next h2, "Classes and specs"): 40 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates - the unbounded scan that yields 59 rows from the "Classes and specs" and per-dungeon blocks was not used. Labels come from each li's alt attribute (lowercase-hyphenated, e.g. "devourer demon-hunter", normalised on both sides) and the value from <span class="mt-1">, so the bar's "height: NN.NNNN%" style cannot be misread as the value. Shape checks: the series sums to 100.3% and the role subtotals are DPS 60.1 / Tank 20.0 / Healer 20.2, i.e. the representation-SHARE column and not the /meta per-key-presence figure that runs 7-10x higher. 0 of 40 values moved against stored. Merged nothing; asOf and the page snapshot both honestly stay at 2026-08-22.

Every channel swept cleanly and there was NOTHING NEW TO LOG - the feed's newest entry is unchanged at 2026-08-22, so success here means the watch completed, not that new data landed. Three live channels: the Wowhead news RSS (40 items, parsed per <item> block, bodies free in content:encoded, newest Sat 22 Aug 22:34:02), the news INDEX payload data.news.newsData (20 posts, anchored on the id attribute and brace-balanced with raw_decode; newest id 382572, and tonight it did NOT lead the RSS - both top out on the same article), and the blue-tracker payload data.blueTracker.default (66 KB, 50 entries, 44 unique topics after deduping by topic id). Nothing about a 12.2 PTR realm, thread or announcement in any of them, and dev-notes thread 2317811 re-polled at highest post 19 (Linxy, 2026-07-31) - the closed cycle's expected silence, not a lost thread. The August 25 tuning entry logged on 08-22 was re-verified against the canonical forum JSON: topic 2339812 post #1 is still v1, updated_at equal to created_at, so the stored distillation is current and needed no amendment. Swept and correctly NOT logged, each checked rather than assumed: news=382569 "Race to World First Day 4 Recap: Mythic Begins, Ula'tek Killed, and Class Tuning", whose title is the trap - the body was read whole (1,128 chars) and is a Dratnos/Tettles recap-video announcement about splits and gearing carrying not one per-spec value; the Mythic Nymrissa Wavecaller nerf and Limestone's "Nymrissa Wavecaller Tuning Changes" blue post (encounter tuning, not class); the Evoker disconnect/Disintegrate bug acknowledgement (no tuning); the running hotfix post 2336376, whose post #1 is at v15 with updated_at 2026-08-22T01:46:38Z, i.e. untouched since the 08-22 run verified its August 21 section has no Classes block at all; and the "Item Adjustment Incoming - August 25" and "Altar of Fangs Adjustments" topics (item and dungeon tuning). No set bonus was touched by anything tonight, so no spec.tierSet needed advancing. PTR zone sweeps (54/52/56/57) remain dormant and were not attempted; their contract rows were removed at the flip. HANDOFF FOR A LOCAL RUN: the freshness heartbeat (check-refresh --age) now reds on gearing-tierset-sync — the gearing subproject still carries the PRE-08-22 4-piece text for Restoration Druid and Retribution Paladin, i.e. exactly the two spec.tierSet entries the 08-22 tuning entry corrected. Verified by diffing gearing/data/specs.json against data/specs.json: 2 mismatches, both set4, both trailing-clause differences. NOT fixed here on purpose: the fix is node gearing/src/sync-tracker-fields.mjs plus npm run gearing:build, and the nightly publish job stages only data/, dist/ and the skill logs, so a gearing edit made by this agent would never be committed. It is a local-run duty (gearing harvests always were).

Discovery complete and clean; distillation produced nothing because there was nothing to read. The seen-set was rebuilt from the four structured lanes (seen[] 543 + skipped[] 408 + videos[] 0 + the 232 distinct youtu.be ids cited in takes/metaNotes = 1,183 ids), never from log prose; 660 feed entries yielded 105 unseen inside the cycle bound 2026-06-18 (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, derived with Math.min rather than indexed), 0 unseen predating it. DISTILLED: 0 takes, 0 metaNotes, no creator latest advanced - transcript-fetch/summary.json reports requested 0, fetched 0, verdict "ok", because the queue was already empty when the deterministic step ran (the five ids queued on 08-22 have since been distilled or skipped). Recorded partial for that reason, not for any failure. QUEUED 5 for the next drain, keyword-filtered as the nightly lane requires against the 100-request monthly budget, all edited analysis uploads about the August 25 tuning pass or the week-one meta: R7kYD23sDQs (Obli, Frost DK buff - its media:description is itself a spec-strength read), 9XtfT9ka2B0 (leak, "Survival Hunter is DOOMED"), xg5sxI6LspI (Kalamazi, Warlock buffs), 5m_K51fnwhc (izen, first Season-2 balance tuning - the metaNotes lane) and 1wxoNsiyCtM (YoDaTV, tank meta + M+ tierlist update). That last one was nearly dropped on the bare-Twitch description shape and was saved by checking the channel's own convention: YoDaTV titles raw restreams "yodatv on twitch" with a bare twitch.tv link, while edited uploads carry a real title plus the same boilerplate. RETIRED 3 ids to seen[] as durable SCOPE dismissals only - nAVBL7mSGsQ and wSlgCYK8Bxo (Supatease, "12.1 PVP Tier List Update" and "New Elite PVP Weapons 12.1") and qmEnXITZFUs (Dalaran Gaming, 5v5 1v1 duels, PvP in title and description) - each a fact about the video rather than a budget cut. The other ~97 stay UNSEEN on purpose (launch-week stream VODs, boss/dungeon guides, RWF day-recaps, and two Supatease titles whose only description is the title repeated), so the next run reconsiders every one of them. yt-dlp was tried ONCE for metadata on 1wxoNsiyCtM and returned "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot" - the settled 2026-07-17 datacenter bot wall - so it was abandoned immediately with no retry and nothing installed or upgraded; the Supadata queue is the only path from a runner. No creator showed coverage outside their registered specs, so nothing is flagged for a scope widening, and no supersession was needed because no take was added.
